description: This Java source file defines the DensityActivity class for an Android application, demonstrating how bitmap and drawable resources are scaled according to display density. It sets up a user interface with multiple views showcasing prescaled and autoscaled images, as well as different drawable types and styles related to density scaling.

classes.name: DensityActivity
classes.description: Main activity for demonstrating density-scaled bitmaps and drawables, with methods to add various image views and handle resource loading.
